question: Which of the following is the common name for ethanol (C₂H₅OH) ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ethyl alcohol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ethanol**, with the chemical formula **C₂H₅OH**, is commonly known as **Ethyl alcohol**. It is a simple alcohol consisting of a two-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group (-OH).
 
• **Ethyl alcohol** is widely used in **alcoholic beverages** due to its psychoactive properties. It is the primary ingredient responsible for intoxication in such drinks.
 
• The term **ethyl alcohol** is derived from the ethyl group (C₂H₅), which is a functional group present in ethanol's structure.
 
• Ethanol is a versatile compound with extensive applications, including its use as a **solvent in industries**, a **fuel additive** (bioethanol), and a **disinfectant** in medical applications.
 
• Other alcohols like **methyl alcohol** (methanol), **butyl alcohol**, and **isopropyl alcohol** have distinct chemical structures and uses, making them different from ethanol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Methyl alcohol (Methanol):**

 
 
• Its chemical formula is **CH₃OH**.
 
• It is also known as **wood alcohol** and is primarily used as a solvent, antifreeze, or fuel.
 
• Methanol is highly toxic and can cause blindness or death if ingested.
 
 
 
• **Butyl alcohol:**
 
 
• Its chemical formula is **C₄H₉OH**.
 
• This alcohol has several isomers and is often used as an industrial solvent or in the production of plastics and coatings.
 
 
 
• **Isopropyl alcohol:**
 
 
• Its chemical formula is **C₃H₈O**.
 
• Also known as **rubbing alcohol**, it is commonly used as a disinfectant and cleaning agent.
 
• It is not suitable for consumption and can be toxic if ingested.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Ethanol:**
 
 
• As a fuel additive, ethanol is mixed with gasoline to create **gasohol**, helping to reduce air pollution.
 
• In the pharmaceutical industry, ethanol is used as a **solvent** for medicinal formulations.
 
• It is also employed in the production of perfumes, cosmetics, and other personal care products.
 
 
 
• **Production of Ethanol:**
 
 
• Ethanol is commonly produced by the **fermentation of sugars** found in crops like corn, sugarcane, and wheat.
 
• Industrially, it can also be synthesized through the **hydration of ethylene**.
